label: Corporate income tax (Körperschaftsteuer) [national]
value: 15% up to 2027, then 14%, 13%, 12%, 11%, 10% in 2028 to 2032, plus 5.5% solidarity surcharge on the tax. Paid by companies resident in Germany and non-resident companies on German income. Körperschaftsteuergesetz § 23; Solidaritätszuschlaggesetz § 4. In force from 1 January 2008.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, solidarity surcharge, social insurance and VAT are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

section: List of taxes: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property taxes
label: Minimum tax on large corporate groups (Mindeststeuer) [national]
value: top-up to 15% effective tax for groups with revenue of €750,000,000 or more. Paid by German entities of in-scope groups. Mindeststeuergesetz §§ 1, 54. In force from 31 December 2023.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, solidarity surcharge, social insurance and VAT are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

section: List of taxes: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property taxes
label: Trade tax (Gewerbesteuer) [municipal]
value: 3.5% of trade income × the municipal multiplier (at least 200% in 2026, 280% from 2027; average 410% in 2025). Paid by businesses and companies (not freelancers). Gewerbesteuergesetz §§ 11, 16.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, solidarity surcharge, social insurance and VAT are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

section: List of taxes: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property taxes
label: Tax on distributed profits (Kapitalertragsteuer) and branch profits [national]
value: 25% withheld on dividends plus solidarity surcharge (two fifths refunded to non-resident companies); no branch profits tax found. Paid by shareholders (withheld by the paying company). Einkommensteuergesetz §§ 43, 43a, 44a.

section: List of taxes: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property taxes
label: Contractor rules: employment status test, § 50a and construction withholding [national]
value: status test of § 7 SGB IV with the DRV status procedure; 15% withholding on non-residents' performance and royalty fees (30% on supervisory-board fees); 15% construction withholding. Paid by clients (withheld by the payer). SGB IV §§ 7, 7a; Einkommensteuergesetz §§ 48, 50a.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, solidarity surcharge, social insurance and VAT are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: § 7 SGB IV Beschäftigung; § 1 Lohnsteuer-Durchführungsverordnung (LStDV) Arbeitnehmer, Arbeitgeber (gesetze-im-internet.de)

section: List of taxes: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property taxes
label: Simplified regimes: small-business VAT exemption and cash-basis accounting [national]
value: no VAT up to €25,000 turnover in the previous year and €100,000 in the current year; cash-basis profit for those not required to keep books (traders up to €800,000 turnover or €80,000 profit); no presumptive income tax. Paid by small businesses and freelancers who use them. Umsatzsteuergesetz § 19; Einkommensteuergesetz § 4 (3); Abgabenordnung § 141.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, solidarity surcharge, social insurance and VAT are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: § 141 Abgabenordnung (AO) Buchführungspflicht bestimmter Steuerpflichtiger; § 4 (3) EStG (gesetze-im-internet.de)

section: List of taxes: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property taxes
label: Non-resident tax on employment income (beschränkte Steuerpflicht) [national]
value: income tax on the normal tariff, withheld as wage tax in class I, on pay for work done in Germany; basic allowance only up to the German pay. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). Einkommensteuergesetz §§ 1 (4), 38b, 49 (1) no. 4, 50; Abgabenordnung §§ 8, 9.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, solidarity surcharge, social insurance and VAT are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: § 1 EStG Steuerpflicht; § 49 (1) Nr. 4 EStG Beschränkt steuerpflichtige Einkünfte (gesetze-im-internet.de)

section: List of taxes: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property taxes
label: Property tax (Grundsteuer) [municipal, Land models]
value: value or area figure × Steuermesszahl (federal model 0.31 per mille for residential property) × the municipal multiplier; Baden-Württemberg, Bayern, Hamburg, Hessen and Niedersachsen use their own models. Paid by property owners. Grundsteuergesetz §§ 10, 15, 25 and the Land property tax laws. In force from 1 January 2025.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, solidarity surcharge, social insurance and VAT are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Grundsteuergesetz (GrStG) §§ 10, 14, 15, 25, 37 and the footnotes on Land deviations (gesetze-im-internet.de; last amended by Art. 32 G v. 2.12.2024 I Nr. 387)

section: List of taxes: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property taxes
label: Real estate transfer tax (Grunderwerbsteuer) [Land]
value: 3.5% to 6.5% of the price, by Land (federal default 3.5%). Paid by buyers (buyer and seller jointly liable). Grunderwerbsteuergesetz §§ 8, 11, 13 and the Land rate laws.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, solidarity surcharge, social insurance and VAT are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Grunderwerbsteuergesetz (GrEStG) § 11 Steuersatz, § 3 Allgemeine Ausnahmen, § 8 Grundsatz, § 13 Steuerschuldner (gesetze-im-internet.de)
